title_original: 인천광역시 서구 명칭 변경에 관한 법률
full_text:
ADDENDA <Act No. 21734, Jun. 2, 2026>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Act enters into force on July 1, 2026; provided, Article 2 of these Addenda enters into force on March 1, 2028.

Article 2 (Amendment of Another Act) Act No. 20605, the Act Partially Amending the Act on the Establishment and Jurisdiction of Courts of Various Levels, is amended as follows:

In the column concerning the jurisdiction of the Northern Branch of the Incheon District Court in Appendix 3, "Seo-gu" is replaced with "Seohae-gu".

Article 3 (Relationship to Other Statutes and Regulations) Where any other statute or regulation in force at the time this Act enters into force refers to "Seo-gu" of Incheon Metropolitan City, the name of which is changed under this Act, such reference shall be deemed to refer to "Seohae-gu" under this Act.
